positives: Only about five miles from Los Alamitos, making repeat visits practical.

Fresh WPN/EventLink now confirms broad current Magic coverage: Thursday Commander, Saturday Commanderfest, Sunday casual play from prior store source, Wednesday draft, Modern, Pauper, cEDH, Standard Showdown, Commander Party branding, and multiple prerelease weekends.
User field notes still give unusually valuable lived texture: Saturday has structured random pods/loose rounds, while Sunday has had a more freeform casual vibe.
WPN Premium status, active official/source stack, and current WPN event breadth make Finch one of the strongest known planning candidates.
cautions: Birdcage and cEDH-forward promotion are meaningful store-character signals but are not the default casual fit.
Sunday casual play remains useful but still needs better Commander-density and best-arrival-window texture.
Saturday Commanderfest may be structured enough to feel different from relaxed open play.

Discord was previously inspected and rated low-usefulness for current Commander intelligence, so pre-arrival coordination still relies more on site/social/user observation than active public LFG evidence.
open_questions: How Commander-heavy is Sunday Finch and Sparrow Casual Play in current practice?
What is the best Sunday casual/open-play arrival window?
What is the current Thursday Commander table texture, bracket mix, and proxy expectation?

positives: Nearby Bellflower location is practical for repeat visits from Los Alamitos.

Prior social/calendar evidence supports an active store-controlled event ecosystem, not just a locator listing.
Prior Discord baseline supports reservations and arranged-group logistics.
cautions: Fresh WPN org reports the store as WPN but not WPN Premium, so the app should not present a current Premium badge without another source.
Discord/reservation evidence helps groups secure space but does not yet prove public solo-arrival pod matching.
Proxy policy and casual power-level norms remain unstated in the currently accepted source stack.
